svg.title: DSR three-phase research design — M²Fabric thesis
svg.desc: Three sequential phases: Phase 1 structured threat modelling produces requirements R1–R8 which feed Phase 2 artefact construction producing M²Fabric which feeds Phase 3 empirical evaluation producing performance results and the algorithm selection framework.
